title: ReLaG: A Scalable Framework Generalizing Random Splits to Data with Latent Relations
abstract: arXiv:2609.38538v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Random splitting can yield non-independent train--test subsets when a dataset contains related samples, as is common in certain applications such as biochemical studies. This leads to overly optimistic generalization estimates. Here, we introduce ReLaG, a modality-agnostic framework that models sample relatedness through a hierarchical latent-variable process and infers groups of related samples using proximity graphs and community detection to produce independent train--test subsets. Across molecular and protein datasets, ReLaG matches existing relation-aware methods while scaling substantially better, enabling splits at previously impractical dataset sizes. We further introduce a label-free procedure that adapts the splitting resolution to production data, aligning evaluation with the intended deployment setting. ReLaG's inferred groups provide a cheap estimate of effective dataset size, enabling diversity-aware dataset scaling. ReLa

translated_title: ReLaG：一个将随机划分推广到具有潜在关系数据的可扩展框架
translated_abstract: 当数据集包含相关样本时（这在生化研究等应用中很常见），随机划分会产生非独立的训练-测试子集，从而导致过于乐观的泛化估计。本文提出了ReLaG，一个与模态无关的框架，它通过分层潜变量过程对样本相关性进行建模，并利用邻近图和社区检测来推断相关样本的分组，从而生成独立的训练-测试子集。在多个分子和蛋白质数据集上，ReLaG的性能与现有关系感知方法相当，同时具有显著更好的可扩展性，使得在以往不切实际的大型数据集规模上进行划分成为可能。此外，我们还引入了一种无标签的程序，可将划分分辨率适配到生产数据，使评估与预期的部署场景保持一致。ReLaG推断出的分组还提供了对有效数据集规模的低成本估计，支持多样性感知的数据集扩展。
tldr: ReLaG是一个可扩展、模态无关的框架，通过分层潜变量模型、邻近图和社区检测来推断相关样本分组，从而为含潜在关系的数据生成独立的训练-测试划分，其可扩展性远超现有关系感知方法，并可支持有效数据集规模的估计与多样性感知的数据扩展。
en_tdlr: ReLaG is a scalable, modality-agnostic framework that infers groups of related samples via hierarchical latent-variable modeling, proximity graphs, and community detection to produce independent train-test splits, scaling far better than existing relation-aware methods while enabling effective dataset size estimation and diversity-aware dataset scaling.
